messages:
Ana: Quick sync — we've got ~20 places using "model family", "model group" and "model-family" and SDK snippets use ModelId vs model_id. Can we agree on a single surface-level term for customer docs and a separate internal config name? Need to update glossary + migration guide. cc @mike @julia
Mike: I vote for "model family" in user-facing docs; it's friendlier. Use `model_group` as internal config key (snake_case).
Julia: Agreed on customer wording. For tone, prefer short declarative sentences and examples first. Add a note in the style guide: prefer 'model family' in headings and H2s.
Kevin: For SDKs: keep type names CamelCase (ModelFamily) and config keys snake_case (model_family). Current JS snippets use camelCase keys (modelFamily) which confuses users. We should standardize across languages in the migration guide.
Sahil: I can run a grep to find occurrences: `git grep -n "model family\|model_group\|modelFamily"` and open a PR with automated replacements where safe.
Ana: Awesome. Also we need a short glossary blurb: one-sentence definition + example. Draft proposal: "model family — a collection of models with a shared architecture and performance profile; used to select runtime variants." Thoughts?
Julia: Love that. Maybe finish with an example: "e.g., 'gpt-redwood-13b' is a model in the 'redwood-13b' family." Keep it customer-friendly and non-technical.
Kevin: I've started a draft PR for docs + code snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — includes python/js examples and a migration note for SDK v2.
rocks-ci-bot: PR 842 created by kevin — CI started, link: https://ci.redwood.com/842
Tara: Happy to review. Can we also add an automated link-check job to catch broken SDK sample links? Found two dead links in the migration guide.
Sahil: I'll add one-line sed for quick fixes: `sed -i 's/modelFamily/model_family/g' docs/**/*.md` but will prefer manual review for headings and titles.
Mike: Good call. For glossary entry, add aliases: "model-family", "modelFamily" as redirects so old links still work.
Ana: Let's aim to merge PR by EOD tomorrow. @tara can you be final reviewer? @kevin can you re-run snippet linter for JS/Python styles?
Tara: Yes. Will check snippets and tone. If CI green we can merge and then queue a small follow-up to fix any missed occurrences.
Kevin: CI passed ✅. Updated snippets to use `model_family` in config and `ModelFamily` in types. All tests green.
rocks-ci-bot: PR 842 — All checks passed. Merge approved by tara.
Ana: Thanks everyone. I'll update the style checklist and add a line in docs CONTRIBUTING.md about naming conventions and example-first snippets.
Julia: Can we also add a short "What changed" blurb at top of migration guide so readers know why terms changed?
Ana: Good idea, I'll add it.
Kevin: Merged. Closing this thread after we confirm no regressions in next release.
Sahil: Ran a final grep — only 1 remaining hit in an archived tutorial, opening follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/317
Ana: Perfect. Closing here. :tada:
